_why.min_height_m: tested in the PX4 simulator at 2 to 15 m with this value. With the default 15 m the program sends nothing indoors.
_why.hold_cfg.h_min: Hold's own floor must not be above min_height_m. Tested at 1.0.
_why.hold_cfg.row_norm: removes mains-lamp flicker bands. Without it the program sent no fix under 120 Hz flicker; with it 8 cm RMS at 5 m (simulator).
